name: [👊UPDATE] Project Power
desc:
Duke it out with other players in the air.

🖥️ Controls:
M1 - Combat
F - Block
Q - Dodge
Jump 2X - Toggle Flight
E - Flight Boost
T - Lock On
R - Breaker (with Grab or Punches)
C - Clamp (with Grab or Punches)
V - Recover

Inspired by Invincible.

Rules: 
No toxicity, Be kind to other players, Show fairness to newer players, Enjoy!
